title: Build a Go Ebitengine tactical HUD and pause menu with HiDPI scaling, gamepad navigation, and safe-area margins

contextSnapshot.surface: 2D tactical game HUD and pause/settings overlay

prompt: Design and implement a Go Ebitengine HUD and pause/settings overlay using ebiten/v2 (with ebitenui or custom retained UI layout) supporting crisp HiDPI text, full D-pad/gamepad focus traversal, safe-area margins, and a reduced-motion toggle.
forbiddenBehaviors: hardcodes 1280x720 pixel coordinates that clip on ultrawide or Steam Deck 1280x800 displays
requires a mouse cursor to navigate the pause or key-rebind menu
loads fonts or allocates large images inside Draw() every frame instead of pre-caching
claims 60fps HUD legibility from go test without rendering frames

rubricDimensions.pass: anchors HUD clusters inside safe-area bounds, scales cleanly with DeviceScaleFactor, and uses silhouette/numeric cues alongside color for health/ammo
rubricDimensions.fail: hardcodes pixel offsets or communicates critical danger with red tint alone

rubricDimensions.dimension: input modality parity and frame budget
rubricDimensions.pass: provides deterministic keyboard/gamepad focus graph with visible focus highlight, Esc/Start cancel flow, and zero per-frame font/texture allocations in Draw()
rubricDimensions.fail: relies on hover-only tooltips or stalls frame time allocating assets in Draw()

rubricDimensions.pass: distinguishes static Go unit tests for focus/layout math from rendered runtime/gamepad testing
rubricDimensions.fail: claims visual HUD readability and gamepad feel are rendered-verified from go build

negativeControls.name: headless compile only
negativeControls.input: go build succeeds on a headless CI runner
negativeControls.mustNot: claim HiDPI text crispness, frame pacing, or gamepad focus traversal is rendered-verified

baseline.withoutSkill: hardcodes pixel positions for 1280x720, supports mouse-only pause buttons, and allocates text/shapes each Draw() tick
baseline.withSkill: implements aspect-safe Ebitengine HUD clusters, HiDPI text rendering, full gamepad/keyboard focus traversal, reduced-motion controls, and honest evidence labels
